bulletin.midday: The Northern Limit of Monsoon passes through 24.5°N/65°E, Barmer, Jodhpur, Rajgarh (Dist. Conditions are favourable for further advance of southwest monsoon into remaining parts of North Arabian Sea, Rajasthan, Haryana and Punjab, and hence entire country during next 2 3 days.

met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure area over East Madhya Pradesh and neighbourhood persists over the same region at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 7th July 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 9.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height. It is very likely to move slowly west-northwestwards across Madhya Pradesh and adjoining areas of southwest Uttar Pradesh and weaken during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now runs from southwest Rajasthan to Bangladesh across the centre of Well Marked Low Pressure area over East Madhya Pradesh, North Chhattisgarh,Jharkhand & Gangetic West Bengal.
The offshore trough at mean sea level now runs from south Gujarat to central Kerala.
A trough runs from Northeast Arabian sea to Bangladesh across Gujarat state, centre of Well Marked Low Pressure area over east Madhya Pradesh, north Chhattisgarh,Jharkhand & Gangetic West Bengaland extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The shear zone now seen as a trough from Northeast Arabian sea to Bangladesh across centre of Well Marked Low Pressure area over East Madhya Pradesh, North Chhattisgarh,Jharkhand & Gangetic West Bengalbetween 0.9 &7.6 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
